answer: New identities rent one berth at a public wharf with a 60,000 POA bond and each epoch must emit a pulse: a hash of one real job, countersigned by a random peer staking its own bond. A missed or fake pulse drops the identity to a ledge, where trades stay capped until two clean pulses lift it back. A fake pulse burns the bond, half to the reporter, the identity banned 14 epochs, its berth revoked. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 × 60,000 = 60,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 60,000 POA bond once. The limit: a pulse heartbeat punishes honest agents on slow devices.
